findings.title: Open Graph metadata is incomplete
findings.recommendation: Add og:title, og:description, and og:url so shared links have clear previews.

findings.title: WhatsApp action is missing
findings.recommendation: Add a WhatsApp action if customers commonly use WhatsApp for bookings or questions.

findings.title: LocalBusiness structured data is missing
findings.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness schema when the page represents a local business location.

findings.title: Organization structured data is missing
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema with a clear name and customer contact point.

findings.title: Visible address details are missing
findings.recommendation: Show a clear address or location cue on the page so customers can confirm where the business operates.

findings.title: Opening hours are missing
findings.recommendation: Show opening hours or appointment availability so visitors know when to contact the business.

findings.title: Primary booking or contact CTA is missing
findings.recommendation: Add a clear booking, appointment, contact, or quote CTA near the main content.

findings.title: Review or testimonial cue is missing
findings.recommendation: Add a visible review, rating, or testimonial cue when customer feedback is available.

evidence.label: Page text
evidence.value: No review, rating, or testimonial cue found

findings.title: Service details are too shallow
findings.recommendation: Add a dedicated service section with several concrete services or treatments.

evidence.label: Service content
evidence.value: No detailed service section with at least three items found

findings.title: Favicon or touch icon is missing
findings.recommendation: Add favicon and apple-touch-icon links so the site looks branded in browser tabs and saved shortcuts.

findings.title: robots.txt is missing or unavailable
findings.recommendation: Publish a robots.txt file so crawlers can discover crawl guidance.

findings.title: sitemap.xml is missing or unavailable
findings.recommendation: Publish a sitemap.xml file so important pages are easier to discover.

findings.title: Map or directions link is missing
findings.recommendation: Add a map or directions link so visitors can confirm the business location quickly.

evidence.label: Links
evidence.value: No map or directions link found
